nextSlice.title: Add Profile-driven naming and project-structure policies
scope: Extend Profile and Report contracts with optional naming and package-path policies
Collect object name and package path as read-only facts without loading unrelated project assets
Evaluate configurable prefix, regular-expression, allowed-root, and forbidden-segment rules in Python
Expose localized naming and directory evidence in the native Chinese panel
Extend fixtures, Demo profiles, tests, real-host evidence, documentation, and screenshots
nonGoals: No asset mutation or automatic repair
No asset rename, move, redirector creation, or package save
No project-wide crawl; only explicitly selected object paths are evaluated
No compatibility claim beyond hosts actually tested
validationCommands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check Content/Python Demo/Scripts tests scripts
